ProphecySummary: Paul says that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, things in earth, and things under the earth, and every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
Fulfillment: Partially fulfilled: confession of Jesus as Lord has begun among believers, but universal bowing and confession by all in heaven, earth, and under the earth is still awaited. Romans 14:11 cites the same Isaiah promise in the context of the judgment seat, and is included as a cross-reference; the judgment-seat entry itself is drafted separately.
